profile.headline:
Software Engineer at Etsy
“Engineering is about solving problems.  Writing code is one tool in our toolbox for how to do that.”
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at Etsy, I bring a unique blend of technical expertise and educational experience to my work. Before transitioning into tech, I served as a Middle School After-School Program Coordinator and Teacher, where I had the privilege of teaching technology and health education to students in grades 6-8. My journey in education began at Brownsville Collaborative Middle School (BCMS), where I worked as the Technology Building Coordinator. I later coordinated after-school programs in collaboration with NYU Langone and Project Reach Youth.

This diverse background has honed my ability to communicate complex concepts effectively and fostered a passion for continuous learning and innovation. I thrive on solving challenging problems, whether it's through coding or helping students achieve their potential.

Beyond my professional pursuits, I enjoy playing video games and am an avid musician, playing both the piano and guitar. I'm also a big basketball fan, with the Lakers being my favorite team.

positions.description: Skills: Swift (Programming Language) · Agile Testing · Dart · Software Development · Google Gemini · Python (Programming Language) · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · Interpersonal Skills · iOS Development · Cursors · Cross-functional Team Leadership · Android Development · Flutter · Communication · SwiftUI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Experienced Software Engineer specializing in seller products development. Passionate about creating robust and user-friendly solutions that empower sellers on digital platforms. Skilled in full-stack development, API integration, and building scalable applications to enhance seller experiences and drive business growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description: Etsy’s first Black and Latinx Engineering Apprenticeship cohort! I am an apprentice for the Design System team. Design Systems ensures that everyone at Etsy is empowered to make consistent, highly performant, and accessible products for our users. We also influence and contribute to global parts of the Etsy experience, leading the charge on creating holistic and brand-aligned experiences.

positions.title: Program Coordinator
positions.description: Conduct program which provides additional health education for students. Provide students with one-on-one mentorship. Create activities and projects to allow students to display their content knowledge, understanding, and creativity.

positions.title: FSW Fellow
positions.description:
Enrolled in an intensive 10-month, Google-funded software engineering fellowship with a 9% acceptance rate (out of1500+ applicants) whose graduates are prepared with both technical and professional skills and have been hired as developers at leading companies such as Pinterest, JP Morgan, and Spotify. Expected graduation: September 2020
Gained hands-on experience with Node, Express, React/Redux, PostgreSQL, APIs, Git, Data Structures, Algorithms, and tech principles and culture via both team/individual projects, code reviews, and pair programming.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Agile & Waterfall Methodologies · JavaScript · SQL, Software Development, Python (Programming Language), Linux, Amazon Web Services (AWS), React.js, Node.js, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Communication

positions.title: Student Fellow
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: As an NYC Tech Talent Pipeline Intern, I participated in a competitive program designed to equip students with the skills and experiences needed for a successful career in the technology industry. I engaged in rigorous coursework and hands-on projects focused on software development, data science, and industry best practices. Working closely with industry mentors, I developed and refined my technical skills in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, and SQL.

positions.title: Building Technology Specialist
positions.description:
I Provide technical support to DOE employees/offices by installing software, troubleshooting operating
issues, and maintaining functionality of all cameras, LCD projectors, smart boards, and audio/visual
equipment. I also provide direct customer service in assisting DOE staff with setup of all computer and audio/visual equipment.

positions.title: Technology Teacher
positions.description:
Passionate and dedicated Middle School Technology Teacher with a focus on nurturing the digital literacy and creative skills of students in grades 6-8. Committed to fostering a dynamic and engaging learning environment that equips young minds with the essential technology skills for the modern world.

Proficient in delivering a comprehensive technology education curriculum, empowering students to develop proficiency in various software applications, coding languages, multimedia production, and information literacy.

Utilize innovative teaching strategies, interactive projects, and hands-on activities to facilitate active student learning, critical thinking, problem-solving, and collaboration. Foster an inclusive and supportive classroom environment that encourages creativity and exploration.

Collaborate with fellow educators, administrators, and parents to align technology curriculum with school objectives and promote interdisciplinary learning experiences. Actively participate in professional development opportunities to stay abreast of emerging technologies and pedagogical best practices.

As a Middle School Technology Teacher, I strive to empower the next generation of tech-savvy learners who can confidently navigate and contribute to our rapidly evolving digital landscape.

positions.title: Technology Instructor
positions.description: Facilitated STEM Middle school afterschool program activities, as well as lead student advisory sessions/workshops. Also conducted lessons in coding in java, graphic design & Poster design making, video production, 3D printing, Robotics, & Computer Repair.

positions.title: Web Development Student Fellow
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description: As a CUNY Tech Prep Fellow, I participated in an intensive and competitive training program that focused on full-stack web development, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices. I collaborated with peers on team projects to design, build, and deploy web applications using modern frameworks and tools. Additionally, I attended workshops, coding bootcamps, and industry events to enhance my technical expertise and professional development.
positions.insights: Skills: Research · JavaScript · SQL, Software Development, Python (Programming Language), Linux, Amazon Web Services (AWS), React.js, Node.js, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Technical Support · Information Technology

Sold merchandise and helped customers have the best experience while they shop.

positions.title: Stock Associate
positions.description: When an associate at Macy’s orders your shoes, the expeditor is in charge of finding the shoe and bringing it to the associate who will then bring it to the customer. If they do not want the shoe, the associate brings it back to the expeditor(s) who are in charge of returning them back to the stock bin.

positions.title: Student facilitator
positions.description: Worked with a non profit organization called Project Reach Youth, which was brached under NYU Lutheran Hospital. There i was trained peer educator to educate teens on issues like H.I.V prevention, abstinence, safe sex and making healthy decisions.

positions.title: Intern for reduce Fare Department
positions.description: I Worked as an Intern with the NYC MTA. Worked under the Manager of New York City’s Transit Reduced Fare Metro Card Program as an assistant to him and his staff.   Duties included auditing and quality assurance of metro cards, terminating void metro cards and other data entry tasks for participants of the reduced fare program
